name: Traffic-Gen
tagline: Realistic multi-source user traffic, security-efficacy tests and bandwidth/packet-loss testing for FortiGate.
description: Traffic-Gen is a Proxmox LXC with a web GUI that generates realistic user traffic (Netflix, YouTube, Facebook, Teams, Office 365, Zoom, Salesforce, OS updates, SD-WAN probes and more) from multiple source IPs and networks. Use it to monitor and demo FortiGate SD-WAN, Application Control and Web Filter with traffic that looks like a real network.

It also tests security efficacy: harmless EICAR/WICAR files check antivirus and IPS, while DGA, DNS-tunnelling, dynamic DNS and mining-pool lookups check botnet and DNS filtering. The dashboard reports blocked, missed and a malware detection rate. The test duration, intensity and traffic mix are all configurable in the GUI. A built-in throughput tester sends UDP, TCP and RFC 2544 streams TCP connections-per-second tests and maximum concurrent session tests through the firewall to a receiver on a second network, and measures bandwidth, packet loss, jitter and latency.

requirements.label: Container
requirements.value: Debian 12 unprivileged LXC, 4 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 4 GB disk by default (created by the installer; 2 vCPU and 1 GB are enough for the traffic generator alone)

requirements.label: Network
requirements.value: eth0 for management, eth1 for test traffic; VLAN tags are set by Proxmox on the NIC

requirements.label: Internet
requirements.value: Outbound access through the FortiGate under test

requirements.label: Throughput test
requirements.value: Optional third NIC (eth2) for the receiver on a different network than the sender; FortiGate policy for UDP/TCP 5201-5208

steps: Run the installer on the Proxmox host and answer the wizard (container ID, management network, traffic bridge, GUI port, admin password).
Open the web GUI on the printed URL (https://<management-ip>:8443) and sign in with the admin password.
Go to Network, add a source network (interface eth1, first IP, number of IPs, FortiGate gateway) and click Apply.
Go to Traffic mix and choose which groups and apps to run. The Web filter, Malware and IOC groups are off by default.
On Traffic mix pick a duration and intensity, then click Start test.
Compare the dashboard and /var/log/trafficgen/requests.log with the FortiGate logs for application control, web filter, antivirus and botnet events.

For bandwidth and packet-loss tests open Throughput, choose the sender network, pick the receiver interface (eth2) and set its IP and gateway in a different network, run Check environment and start a UDP, TCP, RFC 2544, connections-per-second or concurrent-sessions test.

screenshots.caption: Dashboard: welcome page with a short explanation and the three test flows.
Traffic mix: start the traffic test, follow results live (including the malware detection rate) and set the mix per group.
Network: multiple source networks, source IP ranges and FortiGate gateways.
Settings: TLS verification, IOC options and password.
Throughput: RFC 2544 throughput, latency and frame loss per frame size.
Throughput: connections per second with a stepped ramp and the highest sustained rate.
